content: 2026 extension framework landscape: WXT 0.21.4 (published 2026-08-11) is the actively maintained, framework-agnostic default. Plasmo 0.90.5 last published 2025-05-17 and is widely described as maintenance mode / effectively unmaintained. CRXJS @crxjs/vite-plugin 2.7.1 (2026-07-01) is alive but is a Vite plugin rather than a framework, and its content-script HMR has known interaction bugs with MutationObserver (crxjs issues #811, #1119). For a single-file content script with no runtime deps, no bundler at all is the correct choice.
